correctness.rationale: The surface is specified and its smoothness and irreducible geometric pencil fibers are proved in arXiv:2608.15435v1. The nine base points are a single Frobenius orbit: the degree-nine polynomial is irreducible by an independently executed exact gcd test. A choice of geometric elliptic section gives an intersection-lattice isometry between the fiber-orthogonal E8 quotient of the nine-point blowup and the canonical-orthogonal root lattice of the Jacobian del Pezzo. Translation-independence makes it Galois equivariant. Root representatives with H degree 0,1,2 exhaust 72+84+84=240 classes. Nine-cycle orbit counting gives exactly two 3-cycles and twenty-six 9-cycles. For six fixed curves after Frobenius cubed, intersection numbers computed from the root pairing give six disjoint pairs and C6 disjointness graph. The included executable reproduces all finite checks. No local intersection multiplicity or individual curve equation is claimed.
